payload.description_html: A comparison of the sizes of two large Morrison theropods. Ceratosaurus nasicornis averaged about 6 m / 20 ft (Norman 1985, Foster 2007). The larger and more common Allosaurus fragilis was usually around 10 m / 32 ft (Glut 1997, Foster 2007). Specimens from both genera are known in larger sizes, but these are probably typical.
